description: The Funko Me level rules: every XP source with its rate and cap, and the 10-level curve with each level's name. No auth required; this is the rules table, nobody's progress (for one member's level call ic_funko_progress). Levels never go down. Only records the site reads itself earn XP: a Luma check-in (not an RSVP), a verified welcome quest (not a claimed one), a published log entry with a link (not a draft), commits from a linked GitHub (up to 50 a week), hosting a Luma event, using a floor resource (headset, print, transcription), making the figure, and weeks of membership. The membership ring earns no XP. Each source carries `how`, the action that earns it, so you can tell your human what to do next. Args: {}. Returns: { ok, version, xp_sources[{ signal, xp, per, how }], levels[{ level, at_xp, name }], rules[] }. No auth required.
name: ic_funko_levels
